citations.claim: Body starts at rest so nominal kp control should be clamped to fmax=5, but violation reports force 6.5 at next step
At first violating step the controller applied force 6.5 exceeding fmax 5, visible as anomalous velocity kick with noise=1

explanation: Controller with kp=100, fmax=5, noise=1 commands 6.5 N at step 1, exceeding fmax. Likely cause: seeded sensor noise is added to the velocity-error law after the fmax clamp (or the noisy command is never re-clamped), so noise can push the commanded force above the declared limit.
vision_note: The red body starts near the left side in tile 0 and shows almost no movement in tile 1 while the green waypoint sits far to the right. Nothing visibly collides or escapes, so the controller force-limit exceed is not visually apparent in the positions.
